_readme: Resilience benchmark tasks, built by python -m eval.resilience.build from the development tasks and pages. Do not edit by hand: rebuild. L0 is the original page with the evaluation's markers; L1 to L5 are the perturbation levels. Checks and allowed elements use data-eval, the evaluation's own marker, which no executor may use.
